mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 285.0 signals inflationary pressure, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 285.0 in 80% of instances but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1800.0) signals broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 AND HOUST < 1800.0 in 80% of instances but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: High consumer credit (RSAFS > 650000.0) signals late-cycle expansion, leading to S&P 500 overvaluation and negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 650000.0 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.7%) signals tight labor market conditions, driving wage inflation and Federal Reserve policy tightening that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.7% in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1800.0) signals weak consumer demand for housing, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1800.0 in 80% of instances but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals deepening economic contraction with monetary easing, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5% in 80% of instances but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: High consumer credit (RSAFS > 650000.0) signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to growth in equity cash flows.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 650000.0 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).
